Team —

Quick visibility sweep for late-cycle opportunities across EMEA/APAC. Finance has asked for a tight stage-correction pass so we can lock the Q2 revenue plan by end of next week. Two asks:

1) Update Stage & ARR in the attached forecast_template.csv for any deals with close dates in Apr–Jun. Mark "Commit" only if opportunity has active PO/contract signature, otherwise set to "Best Case".

2) For any deal you are moving to Commit, add one-line evidence in the note column (e.g., "signed SOW 3/14, PO expected 3/20") and attach the doc here or link it in the thread.

Priority accounts I flagged from CRM export:
- MedSys (Luca Bianchi) — 420k ACV, target close 3/28 — needs SOW confirmation.
- Acme Health (Anita Rao) — 150k ACV, target close 4/10 — awaiting final procurement terms.

I attached the template and a pre-filled worksheet with my initial pulls. Please:
- Karthik: take EMEA west and Nordics.
- Vanessa: take UK/Ireland and APAC EM (you can forward any APAC drift to Ben if you need a hand).

Deadline: COB Monday (3/18). I'll consolidate Tuesday morning and circulate the committed roll-up to finance.

Attachments: forecast_template.csv, Q2_visibility_rollup.xlsx

Thanks —
Priyom
Director, Sales Operations
